parameter_rationale.observation_definitions: Point-count, elapsed-time, and cumulative-distance cutoffs are reused unchanged from the prior observation-definition sensitivity.
parameter_rationale.quality: The predefined recording-gap, timestamp-order, and implied-speed eligibility flag is reused without changing a threshold.
parameter_rationale.expanded_cohort: The 46-user cohort is the previously analysed union of the 37 evaluation users and nine preliminary users; it is a sensitivity cohort, not an independent replication.
parameter_rationale.tie_rule: Equal-distance candidates are ordered by immutable source trajectory ID; no endpoint outcome determines the order.
parameter_rationale.destination_assignment: The sensitivity replaces only the second-stage nearest-medoid label of each training candidate with its original DBSCAN component; catalogue medoids, empirical supports, retrieval distances, candidate pool, tie rules, scoring, and saved bootstrap plan remain fixed.
parameter_rationale.bootstrap: The exact saved resample plan is reused whenever all 37-user cases are retained. Quality and 46-user analyses use the same 10000-replicate hierarchy with fixed seeds.
